Quick update from initial triage (logs attached: signup_logs.csv, screenshot_signups.png):

- IP cluster: three signups from 52.34.210.0/24 within 28s. Reverse lookup shows AWS EC2 host in us-west-2, fairly common for both legit and bot signups.
- Domain age: acme-ml.com registered 2026-04-09 (72 hours ago). WHOIS indicates privacy protection enabled.
- Email behavior: onboarding@acme-ml.com is a forwarder to multiple provider addresses (observed via MailFrom bounce traces). Looks like a generic onboarding address rather than an individual company email.
- Historical signal: no prior interactions with this domain or contact in HubSpot (linked).

Recommendation: deny manual credit top-up right now and mark as "under review". Keep baseline credits (auto-issued) but limit per-minute token consumption to prevent scripted usage. If customer provides proof of corporate website + LinkedIn pages + brief phone verification, we can escalate to "approved" and issue the one-week extension.

If you want me to flip the flag to "block" I can do that, but I'd prefer the soft hold so we don't break legitimate POCs.

— Vivek
Fraud & Risk Analyst, Redwood Inference
